title: Cross-mode exclusion during pending invitation and lobby expiry rollback
priority: P1 — provar que rollback de expiração de convite 1v1 (120 s) e lobby TagDuel (5 min) preserva o lock do dono e bloqueia o modo oposto até o retry terminal.

expected: one millisecond before deadline invitation remains pending
failed expiry rolls back status/revision and creator lock
retry expires invitation and removes only creator lock
one millisecond before deadline lobby remains active
failed expiry rolls back status/revision and host lock
retry expires lobby and removes host lock

invariants.physicalOwnerLock: only the 1v1 invitation creator and TagDuel lobby host hold locks before acceptance
invariants.playerAssets: players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards snapshots remain identical

limitations: SQLite temporário e stores compilados reais; sem banco persistente.
Deadlines controlados por parâmetro now; sem espera real de 120s/5min.
Verifica exclusão entre stores; não testa gateway Discord real.
